name: heard-as-check-worker
description: Heard-As Check's capture mount for backend-hub: pdf.js in a sandboxed headless Chromium reads a tagged PDF's accessibility tree, then veraPDF checks it, one job at a time.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --input-type=module -e "await import('./src/mount.ts'); await import('./src/driver.ts'); console.log('src loads under node type stripping')"
